chunks: Who place other gods besides God. They will come to know soon.
ai.seo_question: What is the consequence for those who place other gods besides God?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah Al-Muddaththir (often associated with the theme of divine warning) underscores the inevitability of divine retribution for those who commit shirk, emphasizing that Allah’s knowledge encompasses all hidden associations. It serves as a theological anchor for the concept of 'Adl (Divine Justice), reminding believers that polytheism is not merely a ritual error but a fundamental distortion of Tawhid that will be fully exposed on the Day of Judgment. The warning highlights the transient nature of worldly idols compared to the eternal reality of Allah’s sovereignty.
